faqs.oneAnswer: This is a sample collection for exploring the new academy. Purchasing and protected learning will be available after the platform launch.
faqs.twoAnswer: You can explore the academy in Arabic or English. Use the language switcher in the header to change your preference.
faqs.threeAnswer: All course prices are displayed in Saudi riyals (SAR).
faqs.fourQuestion: Can I explore the lesson outline?
faqs.fourAnswer: Yes. Each course page includes its sections, lesson titles, and sample exam information.

About.title: Curiosity is a great beginning.
About.description: We believe useful knowledge should feel within reach. Alabbas Academy is a place to explore new ideas, build practical skills, and make learning a part of everyday life.
About.missionTitle: A little more knowledge. A little more possibility.
About.missionDescription: Our aim is simple: bring clear, practical learning closer to people across Saudi Arabia and beyond, in Arabic and English.
About.practicalDescription: Connect what you learn to something you can do, with examples and practice that make ideas tangible.
About.accessibleDescription: A clear, comfortable experience that gives you room to explore, whether you're starting out or building on what you know.
About.localDescription: An academy with Saudi roots, a bilingual experience, and a belief in the possibility of every learner.
